commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

bankId.description: A bank's id: a version 4 UUID the registering client mints, kept in lowercase.

path.description: The checkout's absolute path on the environment's machine.

role.description: Whether runs may draft into the bank (read-write) or only read and search it (read-only).

enabled.description: Whether runs use this Bank; true when omitted. State import retains the source entry’s enabled flag.

items.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

accounts.description: The accounts whose runs use the bank: all, or the account ids named.

items.description: A repository identity: the one form every spelling of a repository's remote comes down to, https:// then the host without its port and the path of two segments or more, in lower case (repositoryIdentityOf and cases/repository-identity.json). An identity, not a link.

repositories.description: The repositories whose runs use the bank: all, or the repository identities named.

items.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

defaultFor.description: The accounts this bank becomes the default write target for.

importedFrom.description: What the state import registers it from; a repeated one answers the bank registered from it.

environmentId.description: An environment's persistent id: a UUID made on its first start, kept across address changes.

environmentName.description: The source environment's name when the copy was made.

copiedFrom.description: The environment a bank's record was copied from.
